reviews_captured_by_me.text: We used Ortega remodeling and they were great from beginning till end.....they were patient with me picking my countertop and installation was done in one day. I highly recommend using their service

I can't say enough good things about this company! They’ve transformed my home from top to bottom—brand new flooring, interior painted, a stunning kitchen makeover, a beautifully upgraded bathroom, and even a full room addition. Their range of services is impressive, and every project was handled with care and professionalism. Friendly, dependable, and committed to doing quality work. Thanks to them, I finally have the dream home I’ve always wanted!

Fernando Ortega and his team remodeled our kitchen in two weeks flat! I was skeptical they would be able to undertake such a large project with a short timeline, but they delivered as promised…. and for a very reasonable price compared to some of the other estimates that we received! We are now getting ready to do another project with Ortega remodeling for a room conversion.
